pharmacology.text: 5F-PB-22 acts as a full agonist with a binding affinity of 0.468 nM at CB1 and 0.633 nM at CB2 cannabinoid receptors.

uses.text: 5F-PB-22 (5F-QUPIC or Quinolin-8-yl 1-fluoroPentyl-1H-Indole-3-8-Carboxylate) is a designer drug which acts as a cannabinoid agonist.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include heavy sedation, a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, confusion and loss of consciousness. Synthetic cannabinoids of this potency have been linked to seizures, psychosis, kidney injury and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的反應包括嚴重鎮靜、心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、意識混亂與失去意識。效力如此強的合成大麻素曾與癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷及死亡有關，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的反应包括严重镇静、心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、意识混乱与失去意识。效力如此强的合成大麻素曾与癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤及死亡有关，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its quinoline ester structure sets it apart from most synthetic cannabinoids, which use amide links instead. When heated, such esters can break down into products that have raised concern about what is actually inhaled.
fact.zh: 它的喹啉酯結構與多數合成大麻素不同，後者多採用醯胺連結。這類酯在加熱時可能分解成其他產物，令人擔憂實際吸入的究竟是什麼。
fact.zhHans: 它的喹啉酯结构与多数合成大麻素不同，后者多采用酰胺链接。这类酯在加热时可能分解成其他产物，令人担忧实际吸入的究竟是什么。
